legend: Geosé is preparing a problem for the upcoming ICPC Grand Prix of Solidland competition. He is busy writing the model solution and needs your help generating the tests.

The test should consist of a simple polygon with n$$$n$$$ vertices of integer coordinates and area equal to A$$$A$$$. Recall that a polygon is simple if it has no holes and its boundary does not intersect itself. Additionally, the polygon should not contain any internal angle equal to 180∘$$$180^{\circ}$$$.
Build a polygon that satisfies the required constraints, or determine that it does not exist.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases (1≤t≤1,666)$$$(1 \leq t \leq 1,666)$$$. The description of the test cases follows.
The first line of each test case contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and A$$$A$$$ (3≤n≤5000$$$3 \leq n \leq 5000$$$ and 1≤A≤108$$$1 \leq A \leq 10^{8}$$$).
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 5000$$$5000$$$.
output: For each test case, print "No" if such a Polygon can not be built. Otherwise, print "Yes" followed by n$$$n$$$ lines with the coordinates of the vertices of the polygon in clockwise or counterclockwise order. The coordinates of the vertices should be integers with absolute value not exceeding 109$$$10^9$$$.
If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.

legend.ai: Geosé 正在为即将举行的 Solidland ICPC 大奖赛准备一道题目。他正忙于编写标准题解，需要你的帮助来生成测试数据。
测试应由一个具有 n$$$n$$$ 个整数坐标顶点且面积等于 A$$$A$$$ 的简单多边形组成。回顾一下，如果一个多边形没有洞且其边界不与自身相交，则称其为简单多边形。此外，多边形不应包含任何等于 180∘$$$180^{\circ}$$$ 的内角。
构造一个满足所需约束的多边形，或者确定其不存在。

input.ai: 每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量(1≤t≤1,666)$$$(1 \leq t \leq 1,666)$$$。接下来是各测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 A$$$A$$$(3≤n≤5000$$$3 \leq n \leq 5000$$$ 且 1≤A≤108$$$1 \leq A \leq 10^{8}$$$)。
保证所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 5000$$$5000$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，如果无法构造这样的多边形，输出 "No"。否则，输出 "Yes"，随后输出 n$$$n$$$ 行多边形顶点的坐标，顶点应按顺时针或逆时针顺序给出。顶点坐标应为整数，且绝对值不超过 109$$$10^9$$$。
如果有多个解，输出任意一个即可。
